faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before you decide.
faq.a1: Every package is a complete, scoped bundle — typically including discovery, design, full-stack development, QA, and a 30-day post-launch support window. Exact deliverables are listed on each package page.
faq.a2: Yes — all packages can be extended or adjusted. If you have specific requirements, book a call and we'll scope a custom variant at no extra charge for the consultation.
faq.q3: How long does delivery actually take?
faq.a3: Starter packages: 2–4 weeks. Growth packages: 4–8 weeks. Enterprise solutions: 8–12 weeks. We provide a week-by-week delivery schedule before any contract is signed.
faq.a4: Book a free 30-minute consultation. We'll review your requirements, confirm the right package, and send a detailed proposal within 48 hours. No commitment required to book.

about.title: Built by Engineers. Focused on Results.
about.description: Founded by two Iraqi engineers in Turkey — Sehle bridges deep technical expertise with a firsthand understanding of the Iraqi and regional market. We don't just ship software. We solve problems.
about.legacy_p1: Sehle was founded in Turkey by two Iraqi engineers who saw a clear gap: most software companies in the region sold generic platforms instead of building real solutions. We started with one principle — solve the actual problem, not a version of it.
about.legacy_p2: Today our team includes world-class engineers, data scientists, and product designers. Every person we hire must share one belief: that mediocre software costs more in the long run than great software costs upfront.

values.precision_desc: We spec before we code. Every feature earns its place — or gets cut.
values.standard_desc: We apply the same engineering standards used by leading global tech companies — applied to regional business problems.
values.partnership_desc: We're not a vendor. We're a long-term technology partner — invested in your outcomes, not just your invoice.
values.excellence_desc: We'd rather deliver late and excellent than on time and mediocre. Every single time.
